name: m4-72
notes: Sample for milestone 4: 12 questions x 2 conditions x 3 repeats = 72 runs. Questions q01-q12 are the 12 of data/questions/questions.json, in its order (row 2.3); each concept path is the frozen concept.json that `agent concepts pick` writes into the concept session ($CONCEPTS = data/concepts). The budget (60 steps / 2,000,000 tokens, prompt v2) is provisional until the user freezes it after the Slurm e2e test (1.13); temperature 0.7 likewise; both are the same for both conditions. spawn stays off (2.12). Run from the repo root: agent batch agent/manifests/m4-72.json (the deadline comes from $SLURM_JOB_END_TIME, the toolchain from $AGENT_ROOT, the corpus from $CORPUS).
